Three DC06s for $750 is the cheapest way into scrypt — about 990 MH/s merge-mining Doge and Litecoin, payouts straight to your own wallet, and three machines means three chances rather than one.

At 12–20¢ the power bill is the thing to get right, so I'll run it properly next. First miner, or adding to a setup?
Read the hammer mini bundle 3 hammer miner dc06 990 mh s page

Three of them pull about 315 W together — at 16¢ that's roughly $36 a month in power, for $750 all in and 990 MH/s pointed at Doge and Litecoin, paid to your own wallet.

One thing worth knowing first: the DC06 is a presale off an incoming batch, so it ships on a batch date, not this week. Happy to confirm the current date — or if you'd rather have a Bitcoin miner in your hands in days, say so and I'll show you one.
